thread:
Asha: Quick sync — from the postmortem on missing spans we keep seeing the same recurrence: late ETL + partial commits during leader failover. Need clear owners + timelines for remediation and a backfill plan. @Ben @Carla can you take first pass on owners?
Ben: I can own the ETL fix. Plan: add commit visibility, histogram for per-shard lag, and abort on partial commits. ETA: patch in 1 week, canary deploy, full rollout target 2026-03-29. Will post PR here.
Carla: I will own aggregator validation + streaming guards. Two tracks: (1) offline replay + correctness tests to detect overwrites/duplications, (2) streaming job guard to reject partial windows. ETA: tests/harness in 3 business days, fix by end of week. Need infra for replay.
Asha: Assign backfill to analytics — @Lina can you estimate scope/cost for a 30-day backfill and proposed schedule? Also we need SLO impact and customer communication plan.
Lina: Estimate: ~48 node-hours for replay + ~2TB temp storage. Ballpark cost $1.2k. If we run incremental backfill (oldest-first) with throttle we can finish ~72h. Will draft runbook and a maintenance window proposal.
Ben: Root cause looks tied to leader failover race where commit_marker isn't visible to follower before aggregation picks up partial data. Prototype snippet: ```if (!commit_marker.exists()) { retry_or_abort(); }``` planning to add a pre-commit check and a short leader-stabilization delay.
Carla: Adding alert: span_coverage < 95% over 15m -> page oncall. Also adding dashboard tile: "aggregator window success rate" and a 1h historical view for triage.
ops-bot: Created Jira INFR-4512 "ETL partial commit guard" assigned to Ben, due 2026-03-29.
Asha: Action recap: Ben — ETL guard (due 2026-03-29); Carla — aggregator tests + streaming guard (due 2026-03-26); Lina — backfill plan & cost (due 2026-03-25); Asha — coordinate maintenance window + customer note (due 2026-03-27). Daily standup check-ins until items closed. Mark blockers ASAP.
Ben: :thumbsup: I'll post PR link + canary checklist once ready.
Carla: :white_check_mark: started the test harness but need dataset access for replay — @infra-team can we get temporary replay access for me?
Dmitri: Granted replay-access to Carla for 7 days and provisioned 2 extra replay nodes. Created infra ticket INFRA-7623 for quota.
Lina: Drafting the backfill runbook now, will upload to /docs/backfills and ping this thread when done.
Asha: Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem doc with this action table and set a weekly Friday 11:00 status until all actions are green. If anything blocks, please escalate here. :eyes:
